# Vitavolt Global

> Vitavolt Global is an Energy Infrastructure & Intelligence company based in Izmir, Türkiye. Its technology direction combines renewable energy infrastructure, BESS, industrial engineering and energy intelligence.

## Canonical sources

- Website: https://vitavoltglobal.com/
- Investment hub: https://vitavoltglobal.com/investment/
- Research hub: https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/
- AI Discoverability: https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/ai-discoverability.html
- Source repository: https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/vitavoltglobal.github.io

## What Vitavolt is

Vitavolt Global operates across energy infrastructure (GES, BESS, EPC), industrial engineering services and energy intelligence. The public site is the primary source of truth for positioning, services and research status.

## Commercial layer

Public commercial entry points:
- Services: https://vitavoltglobal.com/services.html
- Case studies / technical portfolio: https://vitavoltglobal.com/vaka-calismalari.html
- Contact: https://vitavoltglobal.com/contact.html

Core commercial domains include GES, BESS, EPC, carbon advisory, water systems and energy consulting for industrial and commercial clients in Türkiye.

## VITA Energy Intelligence

VITA is the energy-intelligence layer of Vitavolt Global. It is designed to transform industrial energy inputs into technical, financial and carbon scenarios that support investment decisions.

Planned analytical layers include GES feasibility, BESS sizing, energy scenario analysis, financial analysis, NPV, IRR, LCOE / LCOS, carbon intelligence, carbon offset analysis, technical verification and investment decision support.

NPV, IRR and carbon-offset calculations should only be described as live capabilities when their implementation and validation are publicly verifiable.

## Oxygen ClimateTech / Oxygen Production Facility

Oxygen ClimateTech is an integrated ClimateTech & Microalgae Biorefinery research direction under VITAVOLT CLIMATE TECH. It connects renewable energy, BESS, CO₂ management, microalgae, photobioreactors (PBR), water/heat integration and process control. Experimental data should determine which output combinations are technically and economically meaningful. O₂ is not the sole target; possible research outputs include high-value biomass, O₂ and SAF/biofuel feedstock. SAF/biofuel feedstock is one possible research output among alternatives, not a verified commercial result. Scientific validation and experimental scale-up remain required.

ClimateTech map: https://vitavoltglobal.com/investment/climate-tech.html
Research page: https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/oxygen-climate-tech.html
Turkish article: https://vitavoltglobal.com/blog/oxygen-production-facility-climatetech.html
English article: https://vitavoltglobal.com/blog/oxygen-production-facility-climatetech-en.html
